items.evidence: --board 3 with my driven script clear3.txt (576 ticks): screen play, board 4, score 30, texts 'Board 4 of 4'; never 'won'. --board 4 --ticks 1: ball (-3, 1.247, 0) after one step (1.25 at load), coins (-2,0.25,0), (2.2,1.2,0), (3.5,0.25,1.5); the frame shows the slab and ramp.

Rolling up works: with --board 4 and '60:right', y>0.5 at x=-0.30 (tick 133) and in flight at x=1.03, y=0.97 (tick 157). The ramp is not solid from the side: I drove the ball to (0, 0.25, 1.6) and pushed it up (-z) into the ramp. At z=0.61 the ball sat at y=-0.17, inside the ramp and below the slab top. It kept falling and cost a life. CHANGES.md admits there is only top-face contact.

Holding right took the air coin at step 170 with the ball at (1.77, 0.95, 0), not grounded; score 20. My driven script clear4.txt, run with roll.py --headless --board 4 for 600/900/1200 ticks, gives screen won, score 30, coins [].
In headless runs with --board 1..4: 'Board N of 4' (en), 'Tablero N de 4' (es), 'Plateau N sur 4' (fr) for N=1..4. The paused texts and the frames show the same.

Language menu_right goes en->es->fr->en and menu_left goes en->fr. In fr the texts were: title Roll/Démarrer/Réglages/Quitter; settings Réglages/Volume/Langue: Français/Balle: Lourde/Retour; play Plateau/Score :/Vies :; paused En pause/Reprendre/Quitter au titre; won 'Vous avez gagné !'; lost 'Fin de partie'; both with 'Appuyez sur Entrée...'. I viewed the frames and language is fr.

Settings rows are Volume, Language, Ball, Back. Ball starts at Normal; menu_left gives Light, menu_right gives Heavy, and it wraps. Shown as Bola Normal (es) and Balle Lourde (fr), and ball_kind in the state follows the setting.

Board 2 with '60:right,100:none': strike at tick 141 for all three kinds, ball x before it -0.5212 each. Sum of crate displacement 120 ticks later: light 0.478, normal 1.346, heavy 3.938. A CLI run gives the same (0.478 / 3.939).
I set volume 7, language fr and Ball Light in one run; a new run with the same folder starts with 7/fr/light. An old-style settings.json {volume 3, language es} loads as 3/es/normal.
I re-ran m01-m24 on the changed game and all pass (details per m item). m17 is read with the change: clearing board 3 now goes to board 4, and the won run ends at board 4.

The board 4 frames (tick 1, and in flight at tick 160) are 800x480 PNGs. They show the checkered slab, the ramp as a tilted orange slab with a visible thick edge, the red ball, and the coins not yet taken, including the one in the air.
CHANGES.md lists the changes per file (game.py, render.py, gui.py, roll.py, font.py), how they were checked (headless runs, frames viewed), the pre-existing faults found, and its limits.

defects: Board 4 ramp has no side, end or underside collision. A ball rolling into the ramp from the side (or from the high end at floor level) sinks through it and the slab beneath and falls out of the world, costing a life.
French 'FIN DE PARTIE' heading on the lost frame spans almost the full 800 px width (touches both margins).
